lee juck (singer, lyricist), kim eunha (producer, idol human theatre pd), yang yujin (actor, creator), lee yunjeong (artist, songwriter) talked about #angelbite

👤 i’m actually a moa…that’s txt’s fandom
👥 what’s your favorite song? 
👥 i’m curious too
👤 my favorite song is…one day when i woke up i saw that horns had sprouted on my head 
👥 🤣 wait a minute 
👤 you know what i mean
👥 ‘crown’ yes!
👤 panic (*his duo) has a song named ‘horns’ too so it has something in common with that song
👤 eunha, you’re a producer specializing in k-pop
👥 yes! the reason txt is such a meaningful team to me is because i’ve filmed with them since they debuted, they’re a team that i’ve worked with for every single comeback right from their debut album so i always listen to their music too
👥 you guys might already know but txt is a team that shows the vagrancy and growth of youth in their storyline in a really amazing way
👥 and for this comeback, they’re showing us something new again with ‘youth’ as the keyword
👥 their lyrics were especially really direct and honest so i think it was even more relatable 
👤 a part i really loved was “extravagantly packaged youth, unwrapped it and it’s just anxiety” 
👤 “they say i’m in the prime of my life, they’re half right, prime of struggling” 
👤 it’s not very sweet and not forcefully hopeful, they’re very realistic yet poetic lyrics 
👤 i love it, these lyrics aren’t ordinary
👥 you can feel the honesty
👥 i think they represent how i feel right now well
👤 really? you’re going to keep going into your youth? 
👥 can we hear more about your current feelings?
👤which part is it?
👥 “what should i do? should i just die?” 
👥🤣🤣🤣🤣
👤 no no you can’t feel like that part
👤 but these lyrics really hit you and are so intense 
👥 absolutely
👥 doesn’t idol music usually not use words like these?
👤 exactly 
👥 i really listen to txt’s music a lot…when i first listened to their music, it was “save me” “find me” “i need you” “i’m having a tough time” so at first, i thought “how do they want me to save them…?” but the more i listened to it, the more it felt like the lyrics were telling my story 
👥 for someone in the prime of their youth, it felt like they were telling my story
👤 it feels like my story too though…
👥 anyway! i’m really enjoying this! moa fighting! txt fighting!
👥 they’re going through such a tough time and battling it but they still want to be with ‘you’ and i think you can feel a sense of hope and love in that
👤 “even when everything fails, i want to be together” 
👥 when you have nothing, you really just survive with that one thing but we always miss that
👤 even if it isn’t romantic love, when you’re young, there are things you don’t want to miss out on
👥 i personally have never been this in love with someone…but looking at these lyrics, you can tell it’s about youth because it’s not measured…this is the kind of love that you can experience in your 20s or when you’re young…this is a song about youth. because when i look at my friends, they’re slowly starting to be calculative. i don’t have a single friend that’s like “i have absolutely nothing right now, i don’t have money, i don’t have anything, i don’t even have a figure…yet i still want to be with you.” because they can’t not think about the reality of things. although i’ve never had a romantic love like this…i did things with the mindset of “i can’t give up on this job. i can’t not do this job. i can’t let this go.” 
👤 becoming a producer? 
👥 yes
👤 something you want to keep doing even if you have nothing…even if you fail. 

👤 we cheer on the five members, soobin, yeonjun, beomgyu, taehyun, huening kai’s future activities!

In 1999, NHL legend Mario Lemieux was owed $26 million in unpaid salary by the bankrupt Pittsburgh Penguins. Instead of fighting for cash in court, he took ownership of the team itself.

After leading Pittsburgh to back-to-back Stanley Cups in 1991 and 1992, Lemieux retired in 1997 as one of the greatest players in hockey history. Behind the scenes, however, reckless spending had buried the franchise under more than $100 million in debt.

With the team in Chapter 11 bankruptcy and facing relocation, Lemieux was its largest unsecured creditor. 

Rather than settle for pennies on the dollar, he teamed up with billionaire investor Ron Burkle to outmaneuver corporate bidders in court.

Lemieux converted his $26 million in deferred salary into an equity stake, buying the Penguins out of bankruptcy along with their AHL minor league affiliate.

The move made him the first former player in modern sports history to buy the team he once played for.

In December 2000, he took it a step further. Already inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame, Lemieux came out of retirement to play for his own franchise, recording a goal and two assists in his first game back while serving as chairman and CEO.

Under his ownership, Pittsburgh drafted Sidney Crosby, built a new arena, and won three more Stanley Cups.

When Fenway Sports Group acquired a controlling stake in 2021, Lemieux's $26 million debt conversion had turned into a payout of more than $350 million.

Home sales in the West just hit their slowest pace on record.

Existing home sales in the region fell to the lowest level in data going back to 1999, per the National Association of Realtors. Sales fell 14.5% from a year earlier, the steepest drop of any US region. By comparison, the Northeast fell about 4%.

High prices and mortgage rates above 7% have made the West, home to the country’s most expensive markets like California, especially hard for buyers. Nationally, sales fell to their lowest level since 2010.

Russell Crowe's request to shoot "A Beautiful Mind" in sequence cost production an extra $1 million dollars, says director Ron Howard:
